concerns.text: T004 (Schema Validation) depends on `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`, but T008 (Setup schema) is in Phase 2. T004 cannot execute before T008. Phase 0 tasks T001-T003 must be decoupled from schema validation or T008 must move to Phase 0.

T013 (test_schema_matches_yaml) and T015c (validate parsed data) depend on `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` (T008). T008 is in Phase 2, which is correct, but T013 is marked [P] (parallel) while T015c is not. If T008 is incomplete, T013 fails. Ensure T008 is strictly before T013/T015c in execution order.

T027 (Conditional Residual Model) depends on the output of T026 (Check Collinearity). T027 is marked [P] (parallel), which is incorrect. T027 is a conditional branch that cannot run in parallel with T026; it must wait for T026's result to determine if it runs.
T030a (Apply FDR correction) depends on T030 (Sensitivity Analysis) producing p-values. T030a is marked [P], but it cannot run until T030 completes. This is a hidden ordering violation.

T032 (Causal Language Validation) depends on T033 (Output JSON) or the generation of the interpretation string. T032 is marked [P], but it must run after the model output is generated and the interpretation string is constructed. It cannot run in parallel with the model fitting (T028) or output generation (T033).

T039a and T039b (Write final JSON report) depend on T033 (Output regression_summary.json) and T036-T038 (Visuals). T039a/b are marked [P], but they are aggregation tasks that must wait for all upstream tasks to complete. They cannot run in parallel with T033 or the visualization tasks.
